description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the SearchFace operation for face search
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸搜索SearchFace的语法及示例
name: SearchFace

parameters.help_en:
The database name.

Specify either DbName or DbNames. If both parameters are specified, DbNames takes priority over DbName
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

DbName与DbNames二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，DbNames优先级高于DbName
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The image URL. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html. The URL cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。URL长度不超过1024个字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of face search results returned for a single face list. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单个人脸列表中搜索人脸结果数量限制，取值范围1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The list of database names separated by commas (,). This parameter enables cross-database search and supports up to 10 databases.
Specify either DbName or DbNames. If both parameters are specified, DbNames takes priority over DbName
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称列表，以英文逗号（,）分割，可以实现跨库查询，最大支持10个数据库。
DbName与DbNames二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，DbNames优先级高于DbName
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the face image. If the quality score is lower than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the comparison fails. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score evaluation is not performed
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值。对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示人脸图片质量不符合要求，比对失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.help_en: The number of faces in the input image to search and compare. This parameter controls the number of face sample lists. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 对输入图像中多少个人脸进行检索比对，控制人脸样本列表个数，取值范围1~10，默认为5
parameters.name: max_face_num

MatchList.description_en: The list of matching results. If the input image contains multiple faces, multiple entries are returned
MatchList.description_zh: 匹配的结果列表，如果输入图像中多个人脸，则这里会返回多个数据

FaceItems.description_en: The list of matched face data

Confidence.description_en: The converted confidence score. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A higher value indicates greater similarity. Three recommended reference thresholds are 60.48, 67.87, and 72.62, corresponding to false acceptance rates of 1/1000, 1/10000, and 1/100000 respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower false acceptance rate but also a lower pass rate. Set a higher threshold for scenarios with higher security requirements
Confidence.description_zh: 转换后的置信度 ，取值范围0.0~100.0，数值越大相似度越高，建议的三个参考阈值为60.48，67.87和72.62，分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一的误识率，阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置越高的阈值

EntityId.description_en: The entity ID that uniquely identifies a user, such as a user ID or employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length
EntityId.description_zh: 实体ID，用来标识用户的唯一性，如用户ID、员工ID等。每个实体可包含多张人脸图片。支持大小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度为1~64

ExtraData.description_en: The custom information (string). The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters. The value cannot exceed 512 characters in length
ExtraData.description_zh: 自定义信息（字符串）。支持字母、数字、标点符号和汉字。不超过512个字符

FaceId.description_en: The face image data ID, which must be globally unique and cannot be duplicated. The value can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length
FaceId.description_zh: 人脸图片数据ID，需要全局唯一，不可重复。支持小写字母、数字和下划线的组合。长度为1~64

Score.description_en: The similarity score of the face. Valid values: -1.0 to 1.0, rounded to 6 decimal places. A higher value indicates greater similarity. Three recommended reference thresholds are 0.35, 0.45, and 0.6, corresponding to false acceptance rates of 1/1000, 1/10000, and 1/100000 respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower false acceptance rate but also a lower pass rate. Set a higher threshold for scenarios with higher security requirements
Score.description_zh: 人脸的相似度，取值范围-1.0~1.0，取小数点后6位，数值越大相似度越高。建议的三个参考阈值为0.35，0.45和0.6，分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一的误识率。阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置越高的阈值

Location.description_en: The face coordinate information in the input image
Location.description_zh: 输入图像中的人脸坐标信息

X.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner

Y.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner

QualitieScore.description_en: The quality score of the face in the input image
QualitieScore.description_zh: 输入图像中的人脸质量分
